PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: loc-hell-fortress
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Location guard: transfer only color, light behavior, haze, scale language, and material realism. Do not copy the reference cave, Hell gate, fortress geometry, crowds, or blocking unless this row explicitly requires those elements.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
HELL'S FORTRESS CATHEDRAL — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT, SCALE, LIGHTING, MATERIALS, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Establish INT. HELL'S FORTRESS as a vast subterranean cathedral of suffering in a photoreal live-action biblical epic, captured as a master production-reference wide shot before divine intrusion. The space is an immense fortress nave of black stone: colossal load-bearing pillars of polished obsidian and basalt, each roughly twenty feet in diameter, rise in solemn ranks and vanish into a ceiling lost in layered smoke and shadow. Between the pillars, high walls of dark volcanic stone show iron reinforcements, scarred masonry, and the dull sheen of age-old soot. The architecture reads as fortress-cathedral hybrid—buttressed bays, towering arches, a central processional axis—built to intimidate and imprison, never to comfort.

At the far end of the nave, centered in the composition as the spatial and narrative fulcrum, stands THE GATE: a colossal pair of double doors approximately one hundred feet tall and sixty feet wide, fused iron and bone, their entire surface carved with scenes of eternal torment. Thousands of damned faces form the metal-bone skin of the doors, mouths locked open in silent screams that have lasted millennia. Corroded bronze fittings, hinges, and bands brace the structure; dried blood stains run in dark rivulets down cold metal. The Gate is closed and intact—pre-shatter state, no divine cracks yet, no golden light bleeding through the join.

Flanking and standing before the Gate, towering GUARDIANS in corroded black iron armor hold spears that drip a dark, viscous living substance. Their hollow eye sockets burn with red fire. One figure near center is taller still—the Guardian Leader—horned crest helmet, battle-scarred plate, two-handed weapon or spear ready. They are dwarfed by the Gate yet dominate the human scale, frozen in the tense beat before the ground trembles and golden light descends.

Along the walls and pillar bases, blue-flame torches burn at roughly 2000K, cold sapphire and cyan fire that does not warm the air. Their light throws elongated shadows across the black stone floor—shadows that stretch and dance like grasping hands. A subtle red underglow near the floor and from the guardians' eyes sits at roughly 3500K, a low hellish wash of deep crimson against the colder blue key. Ambient palette: deep crimsons (#8B0000 territory), pure obsidian blacks (#0A0A0A), cold blue torch accents (#4169E1 range), no golden divine radiance yet. The atmosphere is cold, approximately near freezing at floor level, with continuous smoke rising from ground fissures and ash particles suspended in the air like black snow waiting to fall.

Camera: ultra-wide cinematic establishment, approximately 24–28mm full-frame equivalent, low three-quarter angle looking slightly upward so the Gate and pillars overwhelm the frame; deep focus through mid-ground guardians to the Gate surface; subtle atmospheric perspective as smoke thickens toward the ceiling; aspect ratio 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen. Framing places the processional floor axis leading the eye to the Gate; negative space of the smoke ceiling presses downward, reinforcing vertical and spiritual weight.

Materials and texture continuity: black obsidian and basalt stone with micro-fractures and iron banding; gate as iron-and-bone fusion only (never pure wood or pure stone); blue flame only on torches (not orange, not gold); guardians' armor heavily corroded with dried blood and battle scars; bone elements of the Gate visible as pale calcified structure fused into dark iron. Volumetric shafts of cold blue torchlight cut through particulate smoke; no dust motes of daylight, no sun, no sky.

Moment lock from screenplay: the cathedral holds its breath—torches burning, shadows dancing, Gate closed, Guardians at post—before the shaft light arrives, before Jesus descends, before any spear turns to ash or any crack opens in the iron. This is Hell's fortress as pure dominion of death: cathedral of suffering, prison threshold, and throne-room of the gate of Hades.

Strict constraints: photoreal live-action biblical epic production still, not illustration, not anime, not CGI cartoon. No modern objects, no electric lights, no logos, no readable text, no watermarks, no UI, no borders, no captions. No divine gold or warm amber yet. Gate remains closed and whole. One face only on the front of any head among guardians or carved faces—no rear faces on heads. Keep sacred epic tone: monumental dread and scale, not gore-porn or campy fantasy. Reaffirm continuity: blue torches, iron-and-bone Gate at 100×60 feet scale, black stone pillars, smoke ceiling, red-fire guardian eyes, deep crimson and obsidian grade, 2.39:1 wide master of INT. HELL'S FORTRESS before the Living One arrives.
